decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Platform deployment owner with EventStore, Tenants and Parties owners
decisions.requiredOutcome: Supply both exact environment bindings and release/enrollment records; registry issuer, authoritative deployment and two explicitly approved tenants. No existing target established.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Platform identity/secret operations with each capability owner
decisions.requiredOutcome: Supply credential references, only-writer policies, renewal owners and procedures for every role. Generic shared bootstrap and recovery credentials are ineligible substitutes.

Select a qualified existing backend/key hierarchy and show per-original-unit irreversible destruction of every generation, including historical immutable key backups. Reject soft delete, TTL, tombstones and merely denied reads.
Name the independent authority outside the EventStore/OpenBao/ciphertext restore cut; writers, fence/reissue procedure, authenticated time source, skew and currentness bounds.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Platform recovery owner and each copy owner
decisions.requiredOutcome: Close C01–C16 with real locations/generations or authenticated absence; durable work and original receipts, owner-approved targets and independent probes; define receipt minimization and retention.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Platform expiry/monitoring operators and key owner
decisions.requiredOutcome: Name cleanup, escalation and renewal operators; approve bounded retries, outage and receipt-completion limits and prove cryptographic expiry during outage. The five-second library wait is not an expiry SLA.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Parties domain owner, EventStore SDK owner and Platform custody owner
decisions.requiredOutcome: Approve collision/idempotency identity and exact original-binding lookup for establish/rebind/revoke. Revocation effectiveAt cannot create a later deadline for predecessor actor evidence; SDK AdmitAsync lacks binding/logical ID.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Platform host owner with Parties and EventStore integration owners
decisions.requiredOutcome: Approve package/bootstrap path in both actual owning hosts, Party snapshot codec and payload adapter, retained-source reader and independent source admission; no no-op/local-dev fallback.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Parties privacy/domain owner with Platform/8.6 recovery owners
decisions.requiredOutcome: Preserve immediate profile ineligibility and independently bounded actor history; decide all key/backup erasure boundaries and minimal content-free anchor/receipt/continuation retention. Reconcile ordinary backup-key retention with hard actor-purpose expiry.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Parties and EventStore source-contract owners, with Platform authority and privacy owners
decisions.requiredOutcome: Approve proof producer/schema/version/scope/positions/epochs/currentness and erasure classification that proves complete unique successor versions/intervals without retaining expired predecessor actor/provenance/logical evidence. Current strict fold stays closed until accepted.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Administrator/recovery owner, actual deputy and surviving-authority fence owners
decisions.requiredOutcome: Supply exact isolated target, immutable cut, authority reconciliation/epoch hooks, independent observer, outage approval, cleanup scope and verified disposal bound. No target selected.

Supply exact workload UIDs and faults for admission/copy/destruction/receipt commit and lost acknowledgement; operator/observer credentials, duration, abort, cleanup and rollback. 6.1 rollout faults alone do not cover custody failure probes.

decisions.requestedDecisionRole: Project owner acting as Parties Maintainer; Platform and EventStore delivery owners; Product for Branch B launch contract
decisions.requiredOutcome: After decisions, implementation and installed probes exist, accept immutable source/package/image targets, integration date, exact complete Live command and all P-01–P-10 evidence. Keep status Committed until that owner-accepted command passes from clean exact checkouts.

commandBindings.requiredValidation: Exact rendered GVK/namespace/name allowlist, no embedded Secret values, image digests, writer/namespace/hostname isolation.
Closed approved cluster/environment-layer resource list; lock/epoch/fence and exact application/data separation.
Retained package/image digests and source/version bindings, epoch, rollout deadline, failure and cleanup behavior; no data rewind.

commandBindings.operation: Tenant registry enrollment and two-tenant verification
commandBindings.requestedOperatorRole: Tenants operator with Platform identity owner
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Actual authoritative registry/issuer and approved exact tenant references, current enrollment and cross-tenant denial; retain content-free proof.

commandBindings.operation: Credential resolve/renew/revoke and missing-generation readiness probes
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Credential references only; exact only-writer permissions, audience/subject, issuer, expiry/rotation and old-credential denial.

commandBindings.operation: Runtime isolation and trust enforcement probes
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Actual positive and negative network/storage/namespace/Dapr/route controls; no mere label assertion.

commandBindings.operation: Backend purpose/key capability and all-generation destruction probes
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Prove irreversible per-original-unit expiry of all raw/wrapped/backup generations even during outages, with retained unexpired controls.
Authenticated independent placement, time/skew/currentness and terminal nonrollback state; old-writer denial and new-epoch success.
Before/after metadata and digests for actual persisted representations and every copy/key generation; no protected plaintext or key output.

commandBindings.operation: Original-unit cleanup and original outcome lookup
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Exact original tuple and stable operation/receipt, pending work after uncertain outcomes; closed inventory generation and in-flight copy fencing.

commandBindings.operation: Pre-expiry backup capture and immutable version verification
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Genuine data/key/lifecycle cut with complete chain/lineage and independent immutable readback; separate key class.

commandBindings.operation: Isolated restore, reconciliation and cleanup executor
commandBindings.requestedOperatorRole: Approved Administrator or qualified deputy plus authority fence owners
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Exact fenced quarantine target/cut/epoch/hook chain and successful retained controls; no current-authority rollback; verified copy disposal.
Exact workloads, allowed before/after admission/copy/destruction/receipt fault points, restart/lost ack, limits, abort and rollback; no standing production fault credential.
Accepted schema/scope/complete partition and current authority; no expired actor or provenance retained; version/interval uniqueness and positive successor control.

commandBindings.requestedOperatorRole: Project owner acting as Parties Maintainer with delivery owners
commandBindings.requiredValidation: Owner-accepted immutable repositories/submodules, installed targets and command/date; P-01–P-10 plus all installed custody/recovery/fault rows with no skip.

rule: Proposed resources/argv do not populate actual approved bindings. No original null is changed. Local tests and hashes are not installed authority.
